skill.note: Optional short description read from the metadata map (source: codex-rs/skills/src/parser.rs).

events.name: SessionStart
events.note: A session starts, resumes, clears or compacts; matcher filters source: startup, resume, clear, compact.

events.name: SessionEnd
events.note: The main thread ends (close, archive, delete, 30 min idle); matcher filters reason, always other; not for subagents.

events.name: SubagentStart
events.note: A subagent starts; matcher filters agent_type; can add context, cannot stop it.

events.name: SubagentStop
events.note: A subagent stops; matcher filters agent_type; decision block continues the subagent.

events.name: PreToolUse
events.note: Before a local tool runs (Bash, apply_patch as Edit|Write, MCP, function tools); matcher filters tool_name; can deny or rewrite.

events.name: PermissionRequest
events.note: Codex is about to ask for approval; matcher filters tool_name; can allow or deny.

events.name: PostToolUse
events.note: After a supported tool produces output; matcher filters tool_name; can block or replace the result.

events.name: PreCompact
events.note: Before chat compaction; matcher filters trigger: manual or auto; continue false stops compaction.

events.name: PostCompact
events.note: After chat compaction; matcher filters trigger: manual or auto.

events.name: UserPromptSubmit
events.note: A user prompt is about to be sent; no matcher; can add context or block the prompt.

events.name: Stop
events.note: A turn ends; no matcher; decision block continues with reason as a new prompt.

events.name: Interrupt
events.note: The user interrupts an active main-thread turn; no matcher; 1 s default, 3 s max timeout.
